purpose: ARX implementation acceleration and target path-length scale ablation

features.aggregation: equal mean across all fixed disjoint target event windows and intervening gaps; full band covered
features.combination: arithmetic mean of named single features; one auxiliary objective, always 3 objectives total
features.ptc_cost: gamma*expm1(abs(log_frequency_shift)/full_log_frequency_span), sum same-type events in target-midpoint zones, gamma if none, mean target events
features.measured_blocks: fixed overlapping groups of 25 original rows with stride 24, endpoint remainder merged; no new measured samples or interpolation
features.anchor_policy: raw endpoints reported; MAG/PHA retained; no candidate rotation, translation, scaling or frequency registration

selection: Frozen MAG/PHA 2D normalized convex knee; fixed nearest-ideal fallback from 20261011 selector, auxiliary not used for final selection
scope: Three existing development conditions; twelve fresh paired seeds; numerical and speed engineering first, no independent generalization claim.
paired_budget: 60000 candidates per job, report actual frequency queries and wall/CPU time separately
resource_policy: min(32,cgroup quota,affinity) single-thread worker processes; dynamic queue; no scheduled monitoring automation
failure_policy: retain original failures and completed jobs; resume missing jobs only; no silent retry, budget extension or threshold change
publication: Formal local Markdown reports; concise plain-language chat; no website

quadrature.area_method: Native RX-only analytic derivative Gauss prefix, same orders, anchors, convergence tolerance; reference Python retained for regression
quadrature.anchors: Target and candidate pole/zero scales, logarithmically spaced panels around all modes; Case1 uses all six exact branch poles
quadrature.failure: Raise and retain candidate; never substitute a finite bad fitness for unresolved integration

search_control: Four NSGA-II islands of 50, initial 200 split in order, 300 generations, total60000; final knee on combined200; no migration, not guaranteed stronger

light.implementation: RX only; batched native circuit and Gauss prefix integrals; same target/candidate modal panels and convergence thresholds as original
light.local_area: Deferred until scale-only evidence; not optimized in this batch
light.speed_gate: paired ARX_L vs original Python median auxiliary evaluation speedup >= 3 on each target; preflight only, identical hardware and quadrature
